name: slider
useFor: Use to set a number or a span quickly where the exact value shows beside it (a search radius, a size span). Show the value next to the label. For a value under a field with helper text and the snapping lens of the design, use Range.
constraints: A filled bar or a round knob
A slider without its value shown
A slider for a choice between named options
source: Figma "UI · Inputs" (442:107): the Range under the Filled field
title: Slider
description: A ruler: 1px Stone ticks 6px apart in a 16px band, with a 1.5px Forest line as the handle. One value shows only the handle; a range also draws the ticks between its handles in Forest. Vertical turns the ruler on its side.
